name: Nek'rosh's Head
summary: In the Wetlands, Nek'rosh's Head reaches Captain Stoutfist as proof the Dragonmaw chieftain has fallen. Menethil Harbor's defenders can now see that the threat has been broken.

sections.title: A Decisive Strike
sections.body: Across the marshlands, the Dragonmaw clan gathers forces and siege weapons against the Alliance port of Menethil Harbor. After the clan's catapults burn, the port's defense depends on killing Chieftain Nek'rosh. His severed head gives Captain Stoutfist and the Ironforge authorities proof that the warlord's hold over the Wetlands is broken.

faq.answer: Nek'rosh led the Dragonmaw clan remnants in the Wetlands. He directed attacks and war efforts against nearby Alliance territories.

aliases: where do i bring nek'rosh's head
faq.answer: Captain Stoutfist wants Nek'rosh's Head as proof that the chieftain has fallen. He commands Menethil Harbor's defense and offers a reward on Ironforge's behalf.

faq.q: Why was Nek'rosh targeted for death?
faq.answer: Nek'rosh directed the Dragonmaw forces threatening Menethil Harbor. The Alliance sought to cripple the clan's presence in the region by destroying its siege weapons and killing its chieftain.

angles.text: For the Alliance, presenting Nek'rosh's Head to Captain Stoutfist helps defend Menethil Harbor from imminent assault and earns favor with the Kingdom of Ironforge.
As a dwarf, you know the Dragonmaw have plagued Khaz Modan since the Second War. Carrying the chieftain's severed head brings long-awaited justice to the marshlands' defenders.
